conventions.convention: The state set is finite and nonempty, stage energies are finite in joules, β>0 is in inverse joules, and stages are k=0,…,m with m≥1. Each forward stage quenches the energy before applying its row-stochastic bath kernel.

Work and Q_in are positive into the system; F_k=−β⁻¹ log Z_k and ΔF=F_m−F_0. The physical internal-energy interpretation uses one fixed Galilean chart, with bulk and separately tracked external-energy sectors suppressed.

Probability vectors are row vectors. Off-diagonal rates are nonnegative in inverse seconds, diagonal rates are minus their row sums, and detailed balance means π_i q_ij=π_j q_ji with π strictly positive. A graph edge exists exactly when this common flux is positive.
The reverse protocol applies K_k at fixed E_k before reversing the quench E_k→E_{k−1}; its initial law is π_m and its paired work is W_R=−W.

The scalar displacement is measured relative to a fixed trap center and axis in a common Galilean rest chart. Mobility μ, stiffness k, and bath temperature T_b are positive; γ=μk and σ²=2μk_B T_b are adopted model relations.
The OU conclusions assume AC and stationary Gaussian preparation independent of future Brownian increments. The angular-frequency spectrum is S(ω)=(2π)⁻¹∫ C(τ)e^{iωτ} dτ.
Memory entropy uses natural logarithms, hence nats; zero-probability terms are omitted. Reset makes the memory deterministic while preserving the retained-register marginal.
For the reset bound, Q_b is positive into the bath. Endpoint energy is unchanged, W=Q_b, endpoint thermodynamic entropy is k_B H(M,R), and total entropy nondecrease is an explicit assumption.

load_bearing.statement: A forward stage quenches E_{k−1} to E_k at i_{k−1}, then samples i_k using K_k. P_F(ω)=μ_0(i_0)∏K_k(i_{k−1},i_k), W(ω)=∑[E_k(i_{k−1})−E_{k−1}(i_{k−1})], and Q_in(ω)=∑[E_k(i_k)−E_k(i_{k−1})].

For the forward path law of def-td-driven-finite-path-model, under post-td-canonical-protocol-preparation and post-td-stationary-bath-kernel, the finite expectation satisfies E_F[e^{−βW}]=Z_m/Z_0=e^{−βΔF}. This is an ensemble identity; it does not say W=ΔF on each path.

Let S have N≥2 states, positive detailed-balance law π, and connected undirected rate graph. For every strictly positive initial probability vector p(0), the master equation has a unique strictly positive probability solution for all t≥0. D(p(t)∥π) is nonincreasing, and p_i(t)→π_i for every state. No monotonicity of Shannon entropy is asserted.

For the defined reset, assume endpoint entropy S=k_B H(M,R), one ideal fixed-temperature bath T_b>0 receiving Q_b, unchanged endpoint energy with W=Q_b, and ΔS+Q_b/T_b≥0. Then W≥k_B T_b H(M|R). Equality is not asserted without a separately specified reversible implementation.

Assume AC and the linear bath postulate, with X_0∼N(0,V) independent of future Brownian increments and V=k_B T_b/k. Then C(τ)=Ve^{−μk|τ|}, S(ω)=μk_B T_b/[π((μk)²+ω²)], and for every T>0 the time-average variance is at most 2k_B T_b/(μk²T).
For every path ω=(i_0,…,i_m), the endpoint energy change is E_m(i_m)−E_0(i_0)=W(ω)+Q_in(ω), with the stated sign convention.

concerns.concern: Proof 1.1 asserts that the uniformization series and its differentiated series converge uniformly on bounded time intervals and therefore differentiate to p′=pQ, without an explicit estimate or a termwise-differentiation supplier. The stated derivative facts do not themselves justify differentiating an infinite sum. This is readily closed: each coordinate of p(0)Pⁿ lies in [0,1], so on [0,T] the series is dominated by (cT)ⁿ/n! and its derivative series by c(cT)^{n−1}/(n−1)!; a uniform derivative-limit argument then establishes the claimed equation.

seams_checked.note: The bridge supplies a finite nonempty microstate model and adopts its canonical law at positive temperature; it asserts neither dynamics nor equilibration. Protocol preparation specializes exactly that finite branch to E_0 and β=(k_B T_b)⁻¹, explicitly retaining its draft and conditional status. Jarzynski uses that same finite branch. The bridge prose makes no stronger converse claim about protocol dynamics, and the consuming page does not identify finite statistical free energy with a macroscopic potential.
